items.title: Mat Domber interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007
items.q: Mat was interviewed in New York City on January 12, 2007 by Monk Rowe

ctx.x: Mat was interviewed in New York City on January 12, 2007 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are filming for the Jazz Archive at Hamilton College. I’m very pleased to have Mat Domber with me today, founder of Arbors Records and longtime jazz fan.
Absolutely. Jazz fan first of all. Businessman last of all.
